Healed Allies will receive 50% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10s. All hits are guaranteed headshots for 8s after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

obtain: Exotic caches, rifle targeted loot, Cleaners kill squad blueprint
notes: Y7S3 launch notes (Fandom): healed allies receive 200% of Repair Skills as Bonus Armor per stack and repair is 50% of the shot damage. ProtoTrack Oct 2026: 50% of Repair Skills bonus and 50% of total damage. Possible later nerf, no patch note found.

name: Sheriff

talents.name: Autentico
talents.text: +35% Weapon Damage +100% Accuracy No Damage Drop Off. These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

obtain: Manhunt climax mission United Ironworks: General Anderson (guaranteed on first Master clear); Black Tusk kill squad blueprint

name: Big Alejandro

talents.name: Cover Shooter
talents.text: Every bullet fired while in cover increases Weapon Damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15s. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading. swapping weapons or exiting combat.

attributes.stat: Damage to Targets out of Cover

obtain: 10th Anniversary Event pass (tier 46) and anniversary caches; now exotic caches and LMG targeted loot

name: Harrier Pride

talents.name: Rebalance
talents.text: Getting kills and hitting enemies 3 times builds Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage. Getting hit 3 times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance. Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

obtain: 10th Anniversary Event pass and caches; now exotic caches and backpack targeted loot

name: Agitator

talents.name: Perturb
talents.text: While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will prime it. While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when shooting for 20s. Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

obtain: Y8S1 season pass; exotic caches, AR targeted loot, True Sons completion blueprint

name: Investor

talents.name: Slotted
talents.text: Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color: Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency Blue: +1% Armor Regen This item can feature any Core Attribute. This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot. This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health or Skill Repair Attributes.

obtain: Y8S1 season pass; exotic caches, True Sons completion blueprint

name: Whiplash

talents.name: Faster Than Reloading
talents.text: Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied. Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

obtain: Manhunt climax mission Rise Up: The Pentagon, The Director (guaranteed on first Master clear)
notes: Rise Up climax mission opened 2026-05-26.

name: Caduceus

talents.name: Caduceus
talents.text: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

obtain: Y8S2 season pass; exotic caches, AR targeted loot, Cleaners kill squad blueprint

name: Underboss

talents.name: Gangland Hit
talents.text: Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark. More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4. This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own.

obtain: Manhunt climax mission Into the Dark: Tens Nightclub (guaranteed on first Master clear)

name: Prima Donna

talents.name: You can look ... but you can't touch
talents.text: You can look ...: When out of combat, receive 10 stacks. This weapon deals +12.5% Amplified Damage per stack. ... but you can't touch: 1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s.

obtain: Incursion Paradise Lost (1% bosses, 10% final chest)

name: Steel & Sons ACR

talents.name: Shakedown
talents.text: Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks. This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack. Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack. Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplifie Damage from you for 5s.

obtain: Incursion Broken Rain (1% Iris Steel, 3% Marguerite Steel, 10% final chest); Red Moon Rising event
notes: Talent name: Fandom says 'Confirm & Execute', ProtoTrack says 'Shakedown'; in-game name unresolved.
Y8S3 (Ubisoft): max stacks 3 -> 4; weak point kill amplification 10% -> 30%.

name: Fafnir

talents.name: Dragon's Breath
talents.text: This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn to the enemy. An enemy cannot be applied Burn if they are burning already. Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.

obtain: Y8S3 season pass; exotic caches, Red Moon Rising event
notes: PTS values (10% burn chance, 30% of Status Effects bonus) were raised for release to 40% and 50%.

name: Iron Will

talents.text: Your next body shot will be considered a headshot. Cooldown: 2s Requires: Equipped: Marksman Rifle, Rifle or Pistol

obtain: Y8S3 season pass tier 29; exotic caches, Red Moon Rising event
notes: PTS cooldown 1s (PvE) was raised to 2s for release. Added together with the Determined talent change.

name: Sarru

talents.name: Decoy King
talents.text: While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases. Starting from a New Moon, all damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon returns to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle. During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.

obtain: Red Moon Rising event: random drop from XB-35 'Phoebe' Marauder in the Toxic Dark Zone

name: Vertigo

talents.text: Whenever this weapon makes an enemy Suppressed, the enemy is applied Disorient, and you and allies receive +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s.
stats: Damage to Targets out of Cover
